sample_unit: model responses to synthetic emergency vignettes

links.outcome: Triage (CTAS) agreement and undertriage of emergency vignettes by LLMs
links.effect: CTAS exact agreement 14/17 to 15/17 per model; of 13 discordant assignments, nine were undertriage and four overtriage; nine responses flagged for potential harm.
links.quote: Of 13 discordant assignments, nine were undertriage and four overtriage.

links.outcome: Recognition of urgency and appropriate escalation (triage level) by LLMs
links.effect: Nine of 13 discordant CTAS assignments were undertriage and four overtriage; CTAS exact agreement 14/17 to 15/17 per model (p=0.938).
links.quote: Of 13 discordant assignments, nine were undertriage and four overtriage.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of five commercial LLMs on synthetic emergency medicine vignettes for diagnosis, triage, and harm assessment without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
